curated-gf-delius-swash-caps-gf-harmatta: Delius Swash Caps writes in a loose, pen-on-paper hand with short lowercase letters, while Harmattan stays tight and sans, its strokes unvarying (a dream diary would feel at home). Made for brief reading, it moves quickly.
curated-gf-delius-unicase-fs-bespoke-sla: Soft, rope-ladder lettering with a friendly lean. Delius Unicase has rounded, untapered strokes and a tall x-height, and Bespoke Slab sits below as a grounded text serif (fairy tale book cover, perhaps), best at a modest size since long paragraphs aren't its job.
curated-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-serif-:
Delius Unicase draws every stroke at fixed pressure, with no tapering.

It is friendly and loose where Noto Serif Display is sharp, its stout stems and wire-thin hairlines suited to a planner page, and made for brief reading.
curated-gf-devonshire-gf-chakra-petch: Chakra Petch reads crisp and contemporary, its round letters cupped rather than clenched. Devonshire brings the hand-drawn squeeze above it, so give the Chakra Petch text a little more size than feels necessary, since it is made for brief reading.
curated-gf-devonshire-gf-wittgenstein: Friendly, hand-drawn Devonshire sits low and squeezed under a high cap line. Wittgenstein answers with fine hairlines against massive stems and big curved entrances, a literary heft that is the pair's strongest quality, made for brief reading.
curated-gf-diplomata-gf-noto-sans-elbasa: Noto Sans Elbasan reads wide open, with large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut. Diplomata is the opposite, spaced out with counters shut behind slim gaps, so the page alternates between a shut-tight headline and an easy, breathing text.
curated-gf-do-hyeon-fs-erode: Do Hyeon hugs its letters together, with round forms as heavy as the straight ones. Erode follows with a tall middle band and gentle shading, a text serif that would read with dignified ease over many lines.
curated-gf-dynapuff-manrope: Puffy, bold and a bit cheeky. DynaPuff is the one that shouts, each letter alone with space around it, while Manrope quietly does the sentences, its curves open at every mouth.
curated-gf-eagle-lake-gf-kode-mono: Kode Mono reads precise and spaced out, a monospace with unlatched rounds and one steady stroke. Eagle Lake loosens it up on top with a friendly, hand-drawn slimming at the joins, and both are better for brief copy.
curated-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-arrows-gf-ib: Casual, blueprint-like lettering with a short x-height and long extenders. Edu AU VIC WA NT Arrows sketches the headline by hand, and IBM Plex Sans JP finishes each curve with a clean, open gap beneath it.
